`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. I haven't run it or any tests.

The 404 uses `errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", ...)`, which gives an RFC 7807 `problem+json` body. That follows the project's API error-format convention, so clients that parse error bodies will handle it like the other endpoints. I also added the import (`from .errors import problem`).

I didn't save any new memories. The error-format convention was already recorded.
